[1] Manu Feildel (born Emmanuel Feildel in 1974) is a chef born in Nantes, France, trained in England and now living in Australia, most widely known for his participation in Australia's cookery competition programs "Ready Steady Cook", "MasterChef Australia" and "My Kitchen Rules" (MKR).
[2] Masayoshi "Masa" Takayama (高山 雅氏 , Takayama Masayoshi ) (born 1 May 1954 in Kuroiso, Tochigi, Japan) is the chef and owner of Masa, a three-Michelin-starred Japanese and sushi restaurant in Manhattan, New York City.
[3] Celebrity Head Chef is the second series of TV3’s cookery series, Head Chef.
[4] Urasawa is a Japanese restaurant located in Beverly Hills, Los Angeles County, California run by head chef Hiroyuki Urasawa who is a former understudy of Masa Takayama.
